# HappyHomesHub

> Free property management software for landlords, tenants, and handymen.
> Track rent payments, maintenance requests, leases, and expenses in one place.
> First property free forever; tenants and handymen always free. English and Spanish.

## Product

- [Home](https://happyhomeshub.com/): What HappyHomesHub does for each role
- [For landlords](https://happyhomeshub.com/for-landlords): Rent tracking, tenant invites, maintenance, expenses
- [For tenants](https://happyhomeshub.com/for-tenants): Pay rent online, submit repairs, message your landlord
- [For handymen](https://happyhomeshub.com/for-handymen): Free job board with in-app payment

## Help

- [FAQ](https://happyhomeshub.com/faq): Pricing, screening, security, and role-specific questions
- [Contact](https://happyhomeshub.com/contact): Support form and email

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://happyhomeshub.com/blog): Guides on rental costs, insurance, utilities, and market data
